    Presilting differentials on ground projective terms over an algebraic closure #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_presilting_class_of_algebraic_extension_of_finite {k F R : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Fintype k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k F] (P : TwoTerm R) (p : (extendTwoTerm k F R P).source ⟶ (extendTwoTerm k F R P).target) (hp : (let __src := extendTwoTerm k F R P; { source := __src.source, target := __src.target, projective_source := ⋯, projective_target := ⋯, differential := p }).IsPresilting) :
    ∃ (Q : TwoTerm R), Q.IsPresilting ∧ Q.projectiveClass = P.projectiveClass

    Over an algebraic extension of a finite field, a rigid differential on extended terms gives a ground presilting representative of their class.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_presilting_differential_of_extension_of_infinite {k F R : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Infinite k] (P : TwoTerm R) (p : (extendTwoTerm k F R P).source ⟶ (extendTwoTerm k F R P).target) (hp : (let __src := extendTwoTerm k F R P; { source := __src.source, target := __src.target, projective_source := ⋯, projective_target := ⋯, differential := p }).IsPresilting) :
    ∃ (q : P.source ⟶ P.target), { source := P.source, target := P.target, projective_source := ⋯, projective_target := ⋯, differential := q }.IsPresilting

    Over an infinite ground field a geometric presilting differential specializes to one on the very same ground projective terms.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.no_presilting_differential_over_algebraic_extension {k F R : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k F] (P : TwoTerm R) (h : ¬∃ (Q : TwoTerm R), Q.IsPresilting ∧ Q.projectiveClass = P.projectiveClass) (p : (extendTwoTerm k F R P).source ⟶ (extendTwoTerm k F R P).target) :
    ¬(let __src := extendTwoTerm k F R P; { source := __src.source, target := __src.target, projective_source := ⋯, projective_target := ⋯, differential := p }).IsPresilting

    A missing ground projective class never acquires a presilting differential on its extended terms over an algebraic closure.
